Handling includes marshalling, chocks, cones, flight operations assistance (weather, NOTAM, ATC flight plan), documentation, baggage handling, pax/crew ramp transportation, 1 toilet, 1 water, supervision and coordination (landing application, slot, refuelling coordination). Pushback, tow bar, GPU, ACU, ASU on request via another provider at cost + 10% (not priced). Navigation by actual airways (not priced). Airport concession fee 7.5% of handling (5,625 on 75,000). Parking free for the first 3 h, then 880 per 24 h. Immigration and customs arrangement 9,000 per flight up to 5 pax, 500 per additional passenger. Disbursement 10% on all authority fees and recharged services. Return to block with change of load +50% of handling; cancellation less than 24 h 50% of handling. Catering at actual cost.
